text:
mina: Hey team — customer 'jw' is seeing intermittent p99 spikes on the embeddings route plus an occasional dimension-mismatch error. Raising here to triage.

jw_customer: Hi, hitting this from prod. Most calls ok but ~1% fail with "dimension mismatch: expected 1536, received 1537" and we also see p99 jump from ~120ms to 1.2s during busy periods.

kai: thanks for the flag — can you share the raw request payload shape + sdk version? also your model id?

jw_customer: using model redwood-open-1-embedding (1536d). SDK: python 0.9.7. Sample payload (truncated):
```json
{"input": ["short text A"], "batch_id": "b-123"}
```

mina: customer env: lots of tiny requests (single-string), arriving bursty. They have dynamic_batching enabled on our side (default).

ops: I can see their tenant in logs — large fanout, many clients sending single-item requests. Batcher coalesce_window_ms is at default 8ms, max_batch_size configured to 1024 on the pool.

kai: odd — dim mismatch usually means a client-side encoding issue or mixed-model routing (e.g., some requests hitting a model variant with different embedding size). Can you confirm all requests target the same model id and variant?

jw_customer: yes we pin model to redwood-open-1-embedding:v1, but some older clients might still call without version. We also rotate tokens frequently.

mina: reproduction attempt — tested from our side with concurrent single-sentence calls, saw p99 spike when batcher packed >256 items into a batch and then a small subset had slightly different input (emoji/unicode).

kai: interesting. Two working hypotheses: 1) a rogue client sending malformed vector metadata that the runtime mistakes for dimension info; 2) batcher coalescing requests across model variants when variant pin missing (fallback to default).

ops: logs for tenant b-123 show occasional "mixed-model-variant" warnings at batch-assemble time around 3245679950. Example log snippet: 
```
WARNING batcher: assembled batch with mixed_model_variants, dropping requests: [r-9876]
ERROR embeddings: dimensionality_mismatch expected=1536 observed=1537 request_id=r-9876
```

mina: customer also reported auth failures earlier today, might be related to token rotation causing SDK to retry against different endpoint (older client)

kai: next steps for support: ask customer to: 1) pin full model variant in client (model: redwood-open-1-embedding:v1), 2) upgrade SDK to 0.10.x where we tightened model selection, 3) include request_id from error logs. Also temporary mitigation: lower max_batch_size for their pool to 256 or set coalesce_window_ms=4 to reduce large batches.

jw_customer: can we try lowering max_batch_size on our side? how to request that?

ops: I can apply a tenant override for their deployment — will set max_batch_size=256 and coalesce_window_ms=4 for a 30m canary. Doing it now.

sre-bot: deploy accepted: tenant=b-123 overrides applied (max_batch_size=256, coalesce_window_ms=4) by ops at 3245680100.

mina: please monitor for the next 30m and paste any new error request_ids. Also if p99 drops that suggests batching size was the main driver.

jw_customer: initial 5m looks better — p99 down to ~160ms, no dimension mismatch seen yet. Will report if it reappears. Thanks.

kai: follow-up: we should add a safer guard in the batcher that rejects mixed-dimension requests earlier and returns a clear 400 with request_id instead of assembling them. I'll open a ticket.

ops: ticket created: INF-7891 — "batcher: explicit mixed-dimension rejection + better audit logs". Assigning to kai.

mina: closing loop with customer: recommend pinning variant + SDK bump + keep new batcher override until SDK update rolled.

jw_customer: thanks everyone — will coordinate SDK upgrade. Appreciate the quick help :pray:

mina: marking this resolved for now; will re-open if errors return. :white_check_mark:
